attacks.name: Karmic Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| result in the attack roll and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Quantum Bolt
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_medium|.

|!wild| |*Avatar of Life|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| result in the attack roll, this character may choose another allied character within |!range| 4. Each chosen character may remove 1 |!damage| or 1 special condition from itself.

superPowers.name: Universal Translation
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Cosmic Energy Construct
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to that character's defense roll against that attack.

superPowers.name: Chronokinesis
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking or defending, at the end of the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. The attacker and defender reroll all of their attack and defense dice.

superPowers.name: Being of Immeasurable Power
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1. Additionally, this character may have 2 Infinity Gems rather than the normally allowed 1.

superPowers.name: Flight, Gem Bearer [Bonded Soul, Mind, Power, Reality, Space, Time], Peerless
